#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common
# Copyright (C) 2006-2011 OpenWrt.org

START=10
STOP=90

uci_apply_defaults() {
	. /lib/functions/system.sh

	cd /etc/uci-defaults || return 0
	files="$(ls)"
	[ -z "$files" ] && return 0
	mkdir -p /tmp/.uci
	for file in $files; do
		( . "./$(basename $file)" ) && rm -f "$file"
	done
	uci commit
}

pre_wifi_detect() {
	echo "~ pre_wifi_detect ~" > /dev/console

	# load wfo binary
	echo "load wfo binary" > /dev/console
	rboot -z /taroko/wfo-qca-nss-pe0.bin
	sleep 2

	# set CPU port range for l2fp
	if [ -e /proc/driver/cortina/adapt/l2fp/l2fp_debug ]; then
		echo 0x4000 0x12 0x15 > /proc/driver/cortina/adapt/l2fp/l2fp_debug
		echo "enable l2fp port 0x12~0x15" > /dev/console
	fi
}

post_wifi_detect() {
	echo "~ post_wifi_detect ~" > /dev/console
}

adjust_cpu_layout() {
	# adjust cpu layout for Cortina CA8289 solution per Cortina suggestion
	#   core0 --> wifi5g wfo
	#   core1,core2 --> wifi2g rx -> ni tx
	#   core2,core3 --> ni rx -> wifi2g tx
	echo "MSG: adjust cpu layout ..." >/dev/console

	# arrange the interrupt of the Wifi5G wfo driver
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'cortina-pcie-msi-irq' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 8 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
	# arrange the interrupt of the Wifi2G RX driver
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m2 'cortina-pcie-msi-irq' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 2 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
	# arrange the interrupt of the Wifi2G TX driver
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'l2tp_cpu#0x' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 4 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
	# arrange QM EQ8 REFILL
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'QM EQ8 REFILL' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 8 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
       # arrange QM EQ9 REFILL
       irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'QM EQ9 REFILL' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
       test -n "$irq_num" && echo 2 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity

	# arrange the interrupt of wan/gpon0 driver
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'gpon0' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 2 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
	# arrange the interrupt of br-lan/lan driver
	irq_num=$(grep -E -m1 'eth0, eth1, eth2, eth3' /proc/interrupts | cut -d ':' -f 1 | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
	test -n "$irq_num" && echo 4 > /proc/irq/$irq_num/smp_affinity
}

boot_wifi_module() {
	echo "start boot_wifi_module" > /dev/console
	mkfifo /tmp/wifi_module_loaded

	# allow wifi modules time to settle
	sleep 1

	pre_wifi_detect

	/sbin/wifi detect > /tmp/wireless.tmp
	[ -s /tmp/wireless.tmp ] && {
			cat /tmp/wireless.tmp >> /etc/config/wireless
	}
	rm -f /tmp/wireless.tmp

	post_wifi_detect

	# will block here if no one reads fifo
	echo "try to notify wifi_module_loaded" > /dev/console
	echo "wifi_module_loaded" > /tmp/wifi_module_loaded
	echo "wifi_module_loaded has been notified" > /dev/console

	sleep 10
	rm -rf /tmp/wifi_module_loaded
	echo "rm /tmp/wifi_module_loaded" > /dev/console
}

boot() {
	#[ -f /proc/mounts ] || /sbin/mount_root
	[ -f /proc/jffs2_bbc ] && echo "S" > /proc/jffs2_bbc
	[ -f /proc/net/vlan/config ] && vconfig set_name_type DEV_PLUS_VID_NO_PAD

	mkdir -p /var/run
	mkdir -p /var/log
	mkdir -p /var/lock
	mkdir -p /var/state
	mkdir -p /var/tmp
	mkdir -p /tmp/.uci
	chmod 0700 /tmp/.uci
	touch /var/log/wtmp
	touch /var/log/lastlog
	touch /tmp/resolv.conf.auto
	ln -sf /tmp/resolv.conf.auto /tmp/resolv.conf
	grep -q debugfs /proc/filesystems && /bin/mount -o noatime -t debugfs debugfs /sys/kernel/debug
	[ "$FAILSAFE" = "true" ] && touch /tmp/.failsafe

	/sbin/kmodloader

	boot_wifi_module &

	/bin/config_generate
	uci_apply_defaults

	# adjust the cpu core layout
	(adjust_cpu_layout; sleep 60; adjust_cpu_layout; sleep 60; adjust_cpu_layout)&

	# temporary hack until configd exists
	/sbin/reload_config
}

#!/bin/sh /etc/rc.common

START=18

USE_PROCD=1

setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/dhcp" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/dhcp /etc/config/dhcp

  if [ -f "/etc/config/dhcp" ]; then
    [ -d "/tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d" ] || mkdir -p /tmp/dnsmasq.ndk.d
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dnsproxy.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dynamic.conf
    [ -f "/tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf" ] || touch /tmp/dnsmasq.dhcpd.conf

    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv6.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_hsi.conf
    [ -f "/etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf" ] || touch /etc/dns_resolv_ipv4_iptv.conf
    [ -f "/var/resolv_voip.conf" ] || touch /var/resolv_voip.conf
    [ -f "/etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf" ] || touch /etc/configs/filter_dns_resolv_ipv4.conf

    # default behavior is disable dnsproxy and dhcpd function for NDK
    uci delete dhcp.ndk.domain
    uci set dhcp.ndk.cachesize=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk.port=0
    uci set dhcp.ndk_dhcp.ignore=1
    uci commit dhcp
  fi
}

clean_netifd_ndk_config() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_clean_network.sh
}

merge_fw3_firewall_user() {
  [ -e "/sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh" ] && /sbin/ndk_merge_fw3_firewall_user.sh
}

update_ndk_rgwstack() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/ndk_rgwstack /etc/config/ndk_rgwstack

  [ -e "/sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh" ] && /sbin/update_ndk_rgwstack.sh
}

restore_firewall_config() {
  [ ! -s "/etc/config/firewall" ] && cp -af /rom/etc/config/firewall /etc/config/firewall
}

update_etc_resolv_conf() {
  # /etc/init.d/boot: ln -sf /tmp/resolv.conf.auto /tmp/resolv.conf
  # netifd may write dns servers to /tmp/resolv.conf.auto
  # and /etc may be linked to /tmp on some boards(/etc/resolv.conf -> /tmp/resolv.conf),
  # so may override /etc/resolv.conf which should be written by ndk_wand
  if [ -L /etc/resolv.conf ]; then rm /etc/resolv.conf; touch /etc/resolv.conf; fi
}

start_service() {
  setup_dnsmasq_for_ndk
  update_etc_resolv_conf
  clean_netifd_ndk_config
  restore_firewall_config
  merge_fw3_firewall_user
  update_ndk_rgwstack
}
